'''Point Rain''' was the name the [[Galactic Republic]] gave to its primary [[staging area]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="L@PR" />

==History==
Point Rain was a short distance away from the [[deflector shield generator]] protecting [[Poggle the Lesser]]'s [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|primary droid foundry]]. It was a heavily bombarded area, and only [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s forces managed to make it to the staging area, although his ship was shot down and he was seriously injured.<ref name="L@PR" />
